exposure: Glycemic status (normoglycemic, abnormal glucose challenge test, impaired glucose tolerance, GDM)
BMI categories (normal, overweight, obese, severely obese)
outcome: Composite outcome of LGA and/or PCS
cohort: 8595 women who delivered singleton, live births >24 weeks gestation between June 2001 and June 2006
finding: Higher pregestational BMI, maternal hyperglycemia, and above-recommended GWG independently and mutually contribute to adverse pregnancy outcomes, including LGA and PCS.
